lyrics:
dhinna dhinnaa

naa dhin dhinnaa

dekh palatke 

panna panna

aankhon mein masti hein

ulfat ki basthi hein

than man se 

nikle dhuvaa

aise haalat mein humko raahat kahaan

dhinnaa dhinnaa

Ahh naa dhin dhinnaa

ho toofaan jaave mein

jhalke re reh rehke

baahon mein jo jannat hein

sangam ki lijjat hein

lipatke bajaa sanam baajaa

chaknese pehle mazaa na jaa

gul hein khila hua taazaa

ras barsaat nibhaare raajaa

mausam kee neeyat mein hein banvaaniyaan

dhinnaa dhinnaa

Ahh naa dhin dhinnaa

Yeh mehfil mandi hein

har koi graahak hein

Jo chaahe hum se mile

dil se dil milke chale

sukh dukh khoye sanam pal mein

mile teraa dam jo mere dam mein

yaar apni ho kahaan man mein

khoom lo jee bhar ye gulshan mein

hotom pe hein beete na shabye javaan

dhinna dhinnaa

naa dhin dhinnaa

dekh palatke 

panna panna

aankhon mein masti hai

ulfat ki basthi hai

than man se 

nikle dhuvaa

aise haalat mein humko raahat kahaan
